ResearchProjectDef.label: culture studies
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a culture table, where scholars study the goods of the heir nations to earn Culture Knowledge.

ResearchProjectDef.label: translators
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Train colonists to read the old languages of the heir nations, so every studied item teaches more.
Tradition: Studying culture items gives 10% more Culture Knowledge.

ResearchProjectDef.label: envoys
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Send envoys with gifts and letters to the old nations. Traders learn your name and treat you more fairly.
Tradition: Colonists get 3% better trade prices.

ResearchProjectDef.label: culture academy
ResearchProjectDef.description:
A school where the knowledge of every heir nation is copied, compared and taught.
Tradition: Studying culture items gives 15% more Culture Knowledge and colonists learn 3% faster.

ResearchProjectDef.label: world council
ResearchProjectDef.description:
A standing council where every heir nation sends a voice: one hall, one table, nine banners. From here the heirs can be united by vote, or a single power can call them to swear fealty.
Opens after you finish 3 nation stories, or keep 3 trade roads open for a year.

ResearchProjectDef.label: trebuchet
ResearchProjectDef.description: A long arm on an axle with a box of stones at the short end: when the box falls, the long end flings a boulder over any wall. Every heir nation built some kind of it.

ResearchProjectDef.label: embassies
ResearchProjectDef.description: Permanent envoys, sealed letters and a house where foreign guests are received with honour. Opens the embassy, which makes science exchanges and defensive alliances possible.
